info.title: F5 BIG-IQ API
info.description:
F5 BIG-IQ API provides programmatic access to BIG-IQ's centralized management of BIG-IP devices: device discovery, trust, and import; device templates; device management IP pools; license management (purchased-pool and RegKey licensing, utility billing); and device-reference/machine-ID lookup helpers.

Authentication: HTTP Basic (username/password of a BIG-IQ user). BIG-IQ also supports a token-exchange login flow (POST /mgmt/shared/authn/login), but Basic auth is used here for simplicity, matching this repo's convention for Integration Models.

F5 does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec for BIG-IQ. This spec was hand-built from F5's official per-endpoint API reference documentation at clouddocs.f5.com, independently verified path-by-path and field-by-field against the live documentation before inclusion -- endpoints with no official documentation anywhere in F5's reference tree (checked across multiple platform versions) were excluded, as were BIG-IP-device-configuration endpoints reached through BIG-IQ's proxy mechanisms (out of scope; see this repo's F5/BIG-IP folder for direct BIG-IP device management).

Source: https://clouddocs.f5.com/products/big-iq/mgmt-api/latest/ApiReferences/bigiq_public_api_ref/
info.x-itential-curated: Scoped to BIG-IQ's own device-fleet-management capabilities: device discovery/trust/import lifecycle, device and service-catalog templates, device management IP pools, purchased-pool and RegKey license management, and device-reference/machine-ID lookup helpers -- 68 operations, each independently verified against F5's official documentation. Excludes BIG-IP device configuration reached through BIG-IQ's working-config and rest-proxy mechanisms (LTM pools/virtual-servers/nodes, network interfaces, etc.) -- that's BIG-IP's own configuration surface, out of scope for a BIG-IQ management-plane model. Also excludes iHealth, software upgrade, script execution, device backup/restore, and DSC group management, none of which have any official F5 documentation despite being implemented by the legacy F5 BIG-IQ Adapter -- checked across BIG-IQ API reference versions v0.0 through v8.0.0.

get.description: Returns all device management IP pools.

post.description: Creates a new device management IP pool.

get.description: Returns a single device management IP pool.

patch.description: Updates a device management IP pool. Only description, gateway, and addressRanges are patchable.

delete.description: Deletes a device management IP pool.

get.description: Returns license pool member assignments, e.g. for unmanaged/unreachable devices, from the assign/revoke workflow.
Downloads a completed utility billing report by its report ID (from a report task's reportUri).

post.description: Starts activating a standalone (non-pooled) BIG-IP license using a registration key.

get.description: Polls the status of an initial license activation until it reaches READY or ACTIVATION_FAILED.

patch.description: Accepts the EULA or supplies manual license text to complete an initial license activation.

delete.summary: Remove a failed initial license activation
delete.description: Removes a failed or abandoned initial license activation record.

200.description: Remove a failed initial license activation

get.description: Returns all purchased license pools.

post.description: Activates a new purchased license pool using a base registration key.

get.description: Returns a single purchased license pool.

patch.description: Reactivates or accepts a EULA for an existing purchased license pool.

delete.description: Deactivates and removes a purchased license pool.

get.description: Returns all device license assignments for a purchased license pool.

post.summary: Assign a purchased-pool license to a device
post.description: Assigns a license from a purchased pool to a managed device (deviceReference) or an unmanaged one (deviceAddress + credentials).

200.description: Assign a purchased-pool license to a device

get.description: Returns the status of a single license assignment.

patch.description: Refreshes/re-installs a purchased-pool license on the assigned device (state=INSTALL).

delete.description: Revokes a license assignment, freeing the license back into the pool.

get.description: Returns all RegKey (per-device registration key) license pools.

post.description: Creates a new RegKey license pool.

patch.description: Updates a RegKey license pool's name/description.

delete.description: Deletes a RegKey license pool. Fails if any registration key in the pool is still assigned to a device.

get.summary: List registration keys in a RegKey pool
get.description: Returns all registration keys added to a RegKey pool.

200.description: List registration keys in a RegKey pool

post.summary: Add a registration key to a RegKey pool
post.description: Adds a new registration key (offering) to a RegKey pool.

200.description: Add a registration key to a RegKey pool

get.summary: Poll a RegKey offering activation status
get.description: Polls a registration key's activation status until READY or ACTIVATION_FAILED.

200.description: Poll a RegKey offering activation status

patch.description: Accepts EULA / supplies manual license text / retries or reactivates a registration key.

delete.summary: Delete a registration key from a RegKey pool
delete.description: Removes a registration key. Fails if the key is still assigned to a device.

200.description: Delete a registration key from a RegKey pool

get.summary: List a RegKey offering's device assignments
get.description: Returns all device assignments for a registration key.

200.description: List a RegKey offering's device assignments

post.summary: Assign a registration key to a device
post.description: Assigns a registration key to a managed device (deviceReference) or an unmanaged one (deviceAddress + credentials).

200.description: Assign a registration key to a device

get.description: Returns the status of a single registration-key device assignment.

delete.summary: Revoke a registration key from a device
delete.description: Revokes a registration key assignment from a device.

200.description: Revoke a registration key from a device

post.summary: Assign or revoke a license by address
post.description: Assigns or revokes a license pool member by discovery address rather than by device/member UUID -- useful for unreachable, unmanaged, or utility-billing (BYOL) devices.

200.description: Assign or revoke a license by address

get.description: Polls the status of an assign-or-revoke-license-by-address task.

post.description: Generates a utility (usage-based) billing report for a RegKey pool.

get.summary: Get a utility billing report task
get.description: Returns the status of a utility billing report task; reportUri is populated once status is FINISHED.

200.description: Get a utility billing report task

post.description: Creates a device onboarding template used during discovery/import.

get.description: Returns a single device onboarding template.
Returns a deployed application config set (created via apply-template).

post.summary: Apply, update, or remove a template-based application config
post.description: Creates a new application config set from a template (mode=CREATE, default), updates an existing one (mode=UPDATE), or removes one (mode=DELETE) -- there is no separate PATCH for updates, use mode=UPDATE here instead.

200.description: Apply, update, or remove a template-based application config

get.description: Returns the status of an apply-template task.

post.description: Discovers a BIG-IP device and its module configuration so it can later be imported.

post.summary: Discover and import a device in one step
post.description: Combined discover+import super-task spanning modules. Accepts either newDevice credentials or an existing deviceReference per device.

200.description: Discover and import a device in one step

get.description: Returns the status of a combined discover+import task.

delete.description: Deletes a combined discover+import task record.

get.description: Returns the status of a device discovery task.

patch.summary: Cancel or restart a device discovery task
patch.description: Cancels a running discovery task (status=CANCEL_REQUESTED) or restarts it (status=STARTED), optionally with a revised moduleList.

200.description: Cancel or restart a device discovery task

post.description: Imports a device's module configuration into BIG-IQ. Target the device via deviceReference.link (commonly resolved from a machineId via GET /mgmt/cm/system/machineid-resolver/{machineId}).

patch.summary: Cancel or restart a device import task
patch.description: Cancels a running import task (status=CANCEL_REQUESTED) or restarts a finished/failed one (status=STARTED), optionally with a revised moduleList.

200.description: Cancel or restart a device import task

get.description: Returns the status of a device import task, including per-module progress.

post.summary: Remove BIG-IQ management authority from a device (RMA)
post.description: Removes one or more module objects (e.g. adc_core, access) from BIG-IQ's working-config for a device, without removing device trust. Must complete before device-remove-trust will succeed.

200.description: Remove BIG-IQ management authority from a device (RMA)

get.description: Returns the status of a remove-management-authority (Device RMA) task.

post.summary: Remove trust with a BIG-IP device
post.description: Removes device trust between BIG-IQ and a BIG-IP. All module management authority (device-remove-mgmt-authority) must already be removed, or this fails with an error indicating remaining services.

200.description: Remove trust with a BIG-IP device

get.description: Returns the status of a remove-trust task.

post.summary: Establish trust with a BIG-IP device
post.description: Establishes device trust between BIG-IQ and a BIG-IP so it can be managed.

200.description: Establish trust with a BIG-IP device

get.description: Returns all device trust tasks.
Returns the status of a device trust task.

post.description: Creates a reusable application service catalog template.

get.description: Returns a single service catalog template.

patch.description: Updates a service catalog template. name is immutable; description/resources/userScripts/addressSharing/published are patchable.

post.description: Resolves the deviceReference link needed by many other BIG-IQ APIs, given a hostname, address, or machineId plus the target module. Call this first rather than constructing deviceReference links manually.

get.description: Returns all BIG-IP devices trusted by BIG-IQ.

get.summary: Get a trusted BIG-IP device by machine ID
get.description: Returns a single trusted BIG-IP device by its machineId.

200.description: Get a trusted BIG-IP device by machine ID
